title: The Support Team Debate · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写至少80词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short message (about 80 words) to your manager. Suggest one new tool for your team. Say why it is useful and how it can help customers. Use 'to + verb' for purpose and one passive sentence.
Write at least 80 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
